newsitem.title: USA: Aetna completes Brazil joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Aetna completes Brazil joint venture.

text.p: Aetna Inc said Friday it has completed the formation of its previously announced joint venture with Sul America Cia Nacional de Seguros SA, Brazil's largest insurance company.
The joint venture, called Sul America Aetna, will be based in Sao Paulo and will provide health and life insurance as well as pension plans in Brazil, Aetna said.
"This joint venture provides Aetna with an immediate strong presence in an extremely attractive market," said Frederick Copeland, president and chief executive of Aetna International.
"Further, it now positions us to be the leading health insurer in both Brazil and Mexico."
Aetna said its initial investment is approximately $300 million, with up to an additional $90 million over time based on the performance of the joint venture.
The businesses which now comprise the joint venture generated total premiums of $1.2 billion in 1996.
Aetna said its strategic partnership with Sul America Seguros underscores the company's commitment to growth in selected emerging markets.
Aetna currently serves more than 8.5 million customers outside the United States.
Sul America is the largest insurance group in Latin America and Sul America Seguros is the leading insurance company in Brazil with an overall market share of over 18 percent, Aetna said.
